dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a few things...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Let me see what you need, dear customer...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Ah, my sincere apologies, but we are still in the midst of arranging for the goods that you require.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Our capacities are limited, and it will take some time for the goods to be restocked, so please do come again then.
